notes.title: Patch v48 (Dec 1)
notes.notes:
[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Slightly buffed damage and skills for Galaxia and Bolt Cat divine towers.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list] 
[*] Improved targeting logic when manually clicking on an enemy to force target it.
[*] Improved targeting logic when using the "focus bosses" option.
[*] UI fixes and improvements.
[*] Various minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v46 (November 11)
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Lowered cost of energy income upgrade in SWARM mode.
[*] Increased wave requirements for some SWARM related Leaderboard Titles.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Performance improvements.
[*] UI improvements.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where not all enemies were spawning correctly in SWARM mode.
[*] Fixed bug where certain texts weren’t updating correctly after purchasing upgrades in the main menu (this was a visual only bug).
[*] Fixed bug where enemy animations would freeze.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update v44 (October 31)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] New "Sudden Death" progression game mode featuring significantly stronger enemies than Endless mode with some unique mechanics to make it even more challenging.
[*] New "SWARM" competitive game mode featuring super fast paced gameplay with unique mechanics.
[*] New "Tokens" resource earned from competitive game modes, which can be used to unlock a variety of new permanent upgrades and leaderboard flair.
[*] New events scheduled for 2x Tokens and Better Equipment.
[*] Several new powerful upgrades in the Gems Upgrade menu.
[*] New leaderboards, achievements, daily missions, and player icons, titles, and backgrounds.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new "Tokens" resource to the daily resource pack.
[*] Wave 100 drops always drops two equipment pieces.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Button to undo last tile placement.
[*] Indicator showing the path the enemies will follow.
[*] Quick evolve/max buttons.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where rerolling tiles could create invalid tile placement squares.
[*] Fixed some Discord links that weren’t working for new Discord users.
[*] Fixed bug where the level 30 max button wasn’t refreshing when you earned enough resources to afford it.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v43 (October 21)
notes.notes:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] MAX a tower at level 30 for a final +100% DPS boost.
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rerolling a tile will always give a different tile than the last.
[*] You can now reroll away from the cross-path tile on a boss wave.
[*] You can now reroll a cross-path tile (with 2 tower placements) on a non-boss wave.
[*] Lowered daily mission requirements for the Score Attack mission.
[*] The Completionist title requires you to complete the newly implemented achievements as well.
[/list]

[b]QoL Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] UI improvements.
[*] Performance improvements.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Soul Mage's confuse skill was not lasting as long as it should.
[*] Fixed a variety of other minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v42 (October 17)
notes.notes:
[u][b]New Content:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Spend energy to reroll the original tile you are given.
[*] Tier 11 research upgrades.
[*] New achievements and daily missions.
[/list]

[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Unlock and use up to five divine towers, rather than just one.
[*] Significantly increased the amount of gold given from the mid-game resource pack.
[*] Activating "Last Stand" now pushes all enemies back several tiles (as well as gives you 5 extra lives).
[*] Battle Pass and Daily Gift premiums are now permanent (rather than monthly).
[*] Various minor balance adjustments.
[/list]

[u][b]QoL Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Improved user interface.
[*] Improved performance.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a variety of bugs.
[/list]

Please make sure to install this update on ALL DEVICES that you play the game on. If you have mismatched versions of the game on different devices, you may lose data when switching back and forth.

notes.title: Patch v38 (September 26)
notes.notes:
[u][b]QoL Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] You can now cast most Spells between waves, so that they activate as soon as the next wave begins. 
[*] Minor UI improvements.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed rare bug where the game would let you try to equip items on a tower with no slots available, causing the equipment to disappear.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v37 (September 23)
notes.notes:
[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] PC players can spend gems for a "Last Stand" attempt (gives you 5 extra lives) after losing a wave. Also, at waves 25, 50, and 75, you can spend gems for a bonus resource package.
[*] Added a limit in so that you will never get more than 3 of those pesky straight tiles in a row.
[*] Improved the Premium Daily Gifts package.
[*] Improved the Premium Tournament Rewards package.
[/list]

[u][b]QoL Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Active spells will now start and stop counting down at more accurate times (only when enemies are present) to avoid any wasted time.
[*] Significantly reduced the app file size and loading times.
[*] Various UI improvements.
[*] Performance improvements.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The game automatically saves more often now as a failsafe against data loss.
[*] Fixed bug where the stat icons in several menus were incorrect.
[*] Server and account improvements.
[*] Various minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[i][b]Please make sure to install this update on ALL DEVICES that you play the game on. If you have mismatched versions of the game on different devices, you may lose data when switching back and forth.[/b][/i]

[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]

[*] Added a "force save" button in the settings menu.
[*] Various UI improvements.
[*] Performance improvements.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Server and account improvements.
[*] Various minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v31 (August 25)
notes.notes:
[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Adjusted scoring of the Score Attack game mode.
[/list]

[u][b]QoL Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added “G” hotkey for changing game speed.
[*] Various UI improvements.
[*] Performance improvements.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Server and account improvements.
[*] Fixed rare bug where waves would suddenly stop spawning, forcing you to end the game.

notes.title: Update v28 (August 14)
notes.notes:
[u][b]New Content:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] New [b]Tournament[/b] game mode! Compete against others in this biweekly competition to earn unique rewards and upgrades depending on how well you place. This game mode is unique in that all players compete fairly (all upgrades are turned off and all towers are unlocked), putting your strategy to the test. There are also several new technologies and tasks available in this game mode.
[*] New set of upgrades available to purchase with Tournament Points.
[*] New Leaderboard Titles related to the Tournament and Score Attack game modes.
[/list]

[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Score Attack game mode was changed to behave similarly to the Tournament, where all players compete equally with all upgrades turned off and all towers unlocked. This puts your scoring strategy to the test. 
[/list]

[u][b]QoL Improvements:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Changed the upgrades menu hotkey from "Z" to "T".
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Countless bug fixes and improvements related to the UI and server connections.
[/list]
